name: Shikisai
source:
A year between a blind girl and an artist.

"My world is in darkness"

"Kris" was sold off because of her blindness, and "Jet" took her in
to "use her as a model for my work."
Jet was kind to her, and Kris gradually learned to open up her heart.

Enjoy a story through 4 changing seasons between these two characters.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ251863.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
盲眼少女与画家共度的一年。

“我的世界一片黑暗。”

“克莉丝”因失明而被卖掉，“杰特”则以“让她当自己作品的模特”为由收留了她。
杰特待她十分温柔，克莉丝也渐渐学会敞开心扉。

请欣赏两人走过四季更迭的故事。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ251863.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
